copy.heading: Sign-off
copy.subheading: Final review, stakeholder feedback and a certificate.
body: Every engagement ends with a sign-off. Your stakeholders will review your progress, you will take one final assessment, and there will be a dinner party, a tennis match and a certificate, in that order. Please do not bring the certificate to padel.

illustration.concept: Josh in a smart shirt with no cap, standing proudly with a framed certificate in the family kitchen, while Lauren holds Alfie and Mia claps, and his racket bag sits by the back door, zipped up and out of the way.
